jp: 商売が好きで相手が神でも人でも魔物でも分け隔てなく取引を行う。お金にうるさく1gpの無駄も許さない。最近手に入れた石のお金がお気に入り。
jp_grezzo: "商売が好きで相手が神でも人でも魔物でも分け隔てなく取引を行う。お金にうるさく1gpの無駄も許さない。最近手に入れた石のお金がお気に入り。"
en: She loves business and will trade with anyone, whether they are gods, men or demons. She is very picky about money and will not allow even 1gp to be wasted. Loves the stone money she has recently acquired.
en_grezzo: "She loves business and will trade with anyone, whether they are gods, men or demons. She is very picky about money and will not allow even 1gp to be wasted. Loves the stone money she has recently acquired."
it: Le piace commerciare, e tratta senza fare differenze con gli dei, con gli uomini e con i mostri. Sui soldi è pignola e non ammette che si sprechi neanche una moneta d'oro. Ultimamente va matta per certe monete di pietra che si è procurata.

jp: 激昂したヤカテクト。完全に我を忘れており、大事なコレクションを投げつけるなどの暴挙におよぶ。落ち着いた後はそのことで自己嫌悪に陥る。
jp_grezzo: "激昂したヤカテクト。完全に我を忘れており、大事なコレクションを投げつけるなどの暴挙におよぶ。落ち着いた後はそのことで自己嫌悪に陥る。"
en: Yacatect in a rage. She completely loses control of herself and goes on a rampage, throwing her precious collection at people. After she calms down, she suffers from self-loathing over the incident.
en_grezzo: "Yacatect in a rage. She completely loses control of herself and goes on a rampage, throwing her precious collection at people. After she calms down, she suffers from self-loathing over the incident."
it: Yacatect fuori di sé dalla rabbia. Non è più in sé per niente e arriva a scagliare addosso alla gente la sua preziosa collezione. Quando poi si calma, si detesta per quello che ha fatto.

jp: 石像の如き気品を漂わせる巨大な鳥。ほとんど動かないがそれは獲物に警戒心を抱かせないためである。とは言え、その目つきは鋭すぎて警戒せざるを得ない。
jp_grezzo: "石像の如き気品を漂わせる巨大な鳥。ほとんど動かないがそれは獲物に警戒心を抱かせないためである。とは言え、その目つきは鋭すぎて警戒せざるを得ない。"
en: A huge bird with the elegance of a stone statue. It is almost motionless, but this is so as not to alarm its prey. Nevertheless, its eyes are so sharp that one has no choice but to be wary.
en_grezzo: "A huge bird with the elegance of a stone statue. It is almost motionless, but this is so as not to alarm its prey. Nevertheless, its eyes are so sharp that one has no choice but to be wary."
it: Un uccello enorme, che emana la nobiltà di una statua di pietra. Non si muove quasi mai, e lo fa per non mettere in allarme la preda. Solo che ha uno sguardo talmente tagliente che in allarme ci si mette lo stesso.

jp: 弛まぬ鍛錬の末に人である事を捨てたもの。質量のある残像で敵を翻弄し、物量で押し潰す様は正に圧巻。木を隠すなら森の中、隠密機動の真髄がここにある。
jp_grezzo: "弛まぬ鍛錬の末に人である事を捨てたもの。質量のある残像で敵を翻弄し、物量で押し潰す様は正に圧巻。木を隠すなら森の中、隠密機動の真髄がここにある。"
en: A ninja that, after relentless training, has abandoned the idea of being a human. The way it uses its massive afterimages to toy with the enemy and crush them with its sheer mass is truly breathtaking. They say that if you want to hide a tree, hide in the forest, the essence of covert manoeuvre is mastered by this ninja.
en_grezzo: "A ninja that, after relentless training, has abandoned the idea of being a human. The way it uses its massive afterimages to toy with the enemy and crush them with its sheer mass is truly breathtaking. They say that if you want to hide a tree, hide in the forest, the essence of covert manoeuvre is mastered by this ninja."
it: Uno che, dopo un allenamento senza tregua, ha smesso di essere un uomo. Confonde il nemico con immagini residue che hanno una massa vera e poi lo schiaccia con la quantità: uno spettacolo. Se vuoi nascondere un albero, nascondilo nel bosco: l'essenza del movimento furtivo sta tutta qui.

jp: 幼い頃から忍者の厳しい修行に耐えかねてよく家出をしていた。忍者をあまり好ましく思っていない。嫌々やっているため実力が出せていないが、兄や父は影羅に天才的忍者の素質があることを見抜いていた。
jp_grezzo: "幼い頃から忍者の厳しい修行に耐えかねてよく家出をしていた。忍者をあまり好ましく思っていない。嫌々やっているため実力が出せていないが、兄や父は影羅に天才的忍者の素質があることを見抜いていた。"
en: From an early age, she often ran away from home because she could not endure the rigorous training of the ninja. She does not have a very favourable view of ninjas. She has not been able to show her ability because she does not want to, but her brother and father saw that Eila had the potential to be a prodigious ninja.
en_grezzo: "From an early age, she often ran away from home because she could not endure the rigorous training of the ninja. She does not have a very favourable view of ninjas. She has not been able to show her ability because she does not want to, but her brother and father saw that Eila had the potential to be a prodigious ninja."
it: Da piccola non reggeva l'addestramento durissimo dei ninja e scappava spesso di casa. I ninja non le vanno tanto a genio. Siccome fa tutto controvoglia non rende quanto potrebbe, ma il fratello e il padre lo avevano capito, che Eila ha la stoffa del ninja geniale.

jp: 幼い頃から忍者の厳しい修行に耐えてきた。若くして忍者軍団の頭領を務める。非常に厳格。特技は変わり身の術で、熟練の冒険者ですら欺く。
jp_grezzo: "幼い頃から忍者の厳しい修行に耐えてきた。若くして忍者軍団の頭領を務める。非常に厳格。特技は変わり身の術で、熟練の冒険者ですら欺く。"
en: He has endured the rigours of ninja training since childhood. He became chieftain of the ninja army at a young age. Extremely strict.His speciality is the art of shapeshifting, which can fool even the most seasoned adventurers.
en_grezzo: "He has endured the rigours of ninja training since childhood. He became chieftain of the ninja army at a young age. Extremely strict.His speciality is the art of shapeshifting, which can fool even the most seasoned adventurers."
it: Fin da piccolo ha retto l'addestramento durissimo dei ninja, e ancora giovane è diventato capo della schiera. È di una severità estrema. La sua specialità è l'arte della sostituzione, con cui inganna perfino l'avventuriero più smaliziato.

jp: まっすぐで頑張り屋な性格だが、錬金術に関してはマッドな一面も見せる。錬金術の師と色々あって、ふかふかパン恐怖症になっている。
jp_grezzo: "まっすぐで頑張り屋な性格だが、錬金術に関してはマッドな一面も見せる。錬金術の師と色々あって、ふかふかパン恐怖症になっている。"
en: She has a straightforward and hard-working personality, but also shows a mad side when it comes to alchemy. She has a soft-bread phobia after a lot of things with her alchemy teacher.
en_grezzo: "She has a straightforward and hard-working personality, but also shows a mad side when it comes to alchemy. She has a soft-bread phobia after a lot of things with her alchemy teacher."
it: Di carattere è schietta e gran lavoratrice, ma quando si parla di alchimia mostra anche un lato da folle. Col suo maestro di alchimia ne sono successe di tutti i colori, e da allora ha il terrore del pane soffice.

jp: 同じ境遇のシラハとはとても仲が良い。それだけに引っ越すことが決まった際には大泣きし、「定期的に手紙のやり取りをする」と約束するまで離れなかった。
jp_grezzo: "同じ境遇のシラハとはとても仲が良い。それだけに引っ越すことが決まった際には大泣きし、「定期的に手紙のやり取りをする」と約束するまで離れなかった。"
en: She is very close to Siraha, who is experiencing the same difficulties since young. So much so that when she decided to move out, she cried a lot and didn't leave until he promised to exchange letters with her on a regular basis.
en_grezzo: "She is very close to Siraha, who is experiencing the same difficulties since young. So much so that when she decided to move out, she cried a lot and didn't leave until he promised to exchange letters with her on a regular basis."
it: Con Siraha, che ha avuto la sua stessa sorte, va d'accordissimo. Tanto che, quando si decise il trasloco, pianse a dirotto e non si staccò da lui finché non le promise che si sarebbero scritti con regolarità.

jp: ヤギという、紙を食べる生物が祖先にいたらしい。そのせいか紙を見ると無意識に口に運んでしまう。今までに34回ほど、書いてる最中の手紙をうっかり食べてしまっている。
jp_grezzo: "ヤギという、紙を食べる生物が祖先にいたらしい。そのせいか紙を見ると無意識に口に運んでしまう。今までに34回ほど、書いてる最中の手紙をうっかり食べてしまっている。"
en: Goats, a paper-eating creature, are said to have been among their ancestors. Perhaps because of this, when he sees a piece of paper, he unconsciously brings it to his mouth. Until now, he has accidentally eaten a letter he was in the middle of writing about 34 times.
en_grezzo: "Goats, a paper-eating creature, are said to have been among their ancestors. Perhaps because of this, when he sees a piece of paper, he unconsciously brings it to his mouth. Until now, he has accidentally eaten a letter he was in the middle of writing about 34 times."
it: Pare che fra i suoi antenati ci fosse la capra, una bestia che mangia la carta. Sarà per questo che, quando vede un foglio, se lo porta alla bocca senza nemmeno accorgersene. Fino a oggi gli è capitato trentaquattro volte di mangiarsi per sbaglio la lettera che stava scrivendo.

jp: 安住の地を求めて街から街へと渡り歩く根無し草。資金を得て観光客になるか、力を得て冒険者や傭兵になるか人それぞれの道である。
jp_grezzo: "安住の地を求めて街から街へと渡り歩く根無し草。資金を得て観光客になるか、力を得て冒険者や傭兵になるか人それぞれの道である。"
en: Rootless people go from town to town in search of a safe haven. Each person's path is his or her own, whether to become a tourist for funds or an adventurer or mercenary for power.
en_grezzo: "Rootless people go from town to town in search of a safe haven. Each person's path is his or her own, whether to become a tourist for funds or an adventurer or mercenary for power."
it: Gente senza radici, che va di città in città in cerca di un posto dove fermarsi in pace. Chi mette insieme i quattrini si fa turista, chi mette insieme la forza va all'avventura o si fa mercenario: ognuno prende la sua strada.

jp: 森を焼かれロスリアに移住したが、ロスリアの堕落とともに世界中へと散らばった難民。彼らは故郷も希望も失ったのに、真実が明かされた後も迫害だけは残っていた。
jp_grezzo: "森を焼かれロスリアに移住したが、ロスリアの堕落とともに世界中へと散らばった難民。彼らは故郷も希望も失ったのに、真実が明かされた後も迫害だけは残っていた。"
en: The refugees, who were burned out of their forests and settled in Lothria, were scattered all over the world with the fall of Lothria. They lost their homes and hope, but only persecution remained after the truth was revealed.
en_grezzo: "The refugees, who were burned out of their forests and settled in Lothria, were scattered all over the world with the fall of Lothria. They lost their homes and hope, but only persecution remained after the truth was revealed. "
it: Gli hanno bruciato la foresta e sono andati a stare a Lothria; poi Lothria è caduta in disgrazia e loro si sono sparsi per il mondo. Avevano perduto la patria e la speranza, e quando la verità è venuta a galla l'unica cosa che è rimasta è stata la persecuzione.

jp: カジノは誰をも拒むこと無く、一攫千金を夢見る者を歓迎する。カジノスタッフは、彼らがギャンブルに挑むその姿を心から応援しているのだ。その客が金を落とす限りは。
jp_grezzo: "カジノは誰をも拒むこと無く、一攫千金を夢見る者を歓迎する。カジノスタッフは、彼らがギャンブルに挑むその姿を心から応援しているのだ。その客が金を落とす限りは。"
en: The casino never rejects anyone and welcomes those who dream of getting rich. The casino staff are heartily supportive of their gambling endeavours. As long as the customer loses money.
en_grezzo: "The casino never rejects anyone and welcomes those who dream of getting rich. The casino staff are heartily supportive of their gambling endeavours. As long as the customer loses money."
it: Il casinò non respinge nessuno e accoglie a braccia aperte chi sogna di far fortuna in un colpo solo. E gli addetti fanno il tifo di cuore per chi si mette a giocare. Finché quel cliente lascia soldi sul tavolo.

jp: 我を殺し姿を潜め色々と黒い仕事をこなす者。中距離からの手裏剣と鎖鎌で相手の血と体力をジワジワと削り取る汚いやつ。仕事が無いときは農業などをして暮らしている。
jp_grezzo: "我を殺し姿を潜め色々と黒い仕事をこなす者。中距離からの手裏剣と鎖鎌で相手の血と体力をジワジワと削り取る汚いやつ。仕事が無いときは農業などをして暮らしている。"
en: A man who keeps to himself and hides in plain sight, performing all sorts of black work. This nasty fellow uses shuriken and chain scythes from medium range to slowly drain the blood and strength of the opponent. When not working, they live by farming.
en_grezzo: "A man who keeps to himself and hides in plain sight, performing all sorts of black work. This nasty fellow uses shuriken and chain scythes from medium range to slowly drain the blood and strength of the opponent. When not working, they live by farming."
it: Uno che mette da parte sé stesso, si nasconde e sbriga ogni sorta di lavoro sporco. Un tipo scorretto: da mezza distanza, con gli shuriken e la falce a catena, ti porta via il sangue e le forze un po' per volta. Quando non ha lavoro campa coltivando la terra.

jp: 斬り伏せた敵の魂を吸収し強大な力を自らの物としたブレイド。重力制御能力を持ち、簡単な飛行も可能。強敵と相対するとき、その力が全開する。
jp_grezzo: "斬り伏せた敵の魂を吸収し強大な力を自らの物としたブレイド。重力制御能力を持ち、簡単な飛行も可能。強敵と相対するとき、その力が全開する。"
en: A blade that absorbs the souls of enemies it has slain and takes their mighty power for itself. It has the ability to control gravity and is capable of simple flight. Its full power is unleashed when facing powerful enemies.
en_grezzo: "A blade that absorbs the souls of enemies it has slain and takes their mighty power for itself. It has the ability to control gravity and is capable of simple flight. Its full power is unleashed when facing powerful enemies."
it: Una lama che ha assorbito le anime dei nemici abbattuti e ne ha fatto propria la forza smisurata. Sa comandare la gravità e riesce perfino a volare, alla buona. Quando si trova davanti un avversario forte, quella forza si scatena tutta.

jp: 海がとても好きで、綺麗な海岸線が広がるヴァルムへ遊びに来ている。海へ行くのが楽しみ過ぎて水着を着たまま来てしまった為に、着替えがなくて後で困る。
jp_grezzo: "海がとても好きで、綺麗な海岸線が広がるヴァルムへ遊びに来ている。海へ行くのが楽しみ過ぎて水着を着たまま来てしまった為に、着替えがなくて後で困る。"
en: They like the sea very much and come to visit Valm, where there is a beautiful coastline. They are too excited to go to the sea, so they come here in their swimming costumes and later get into trouble because they don't have any clothes to change into.
en_grezzo: "They like the sea very much and come to visit Valm, where there is a beautiful coastline. They are too excited to go to the sea, so they come here in their swimming costumes and later get into trouble because they don't have any clothes to change into."
it: Ama moltissimo il mare, e viene a divertirsi a Valm, dove la costa è bellissima. Ma non stava più nella pelle all'idea di andarci, ed è partito già col costume addosso: da cambiarsi non ha niente, e dopo saranno guai.

jp: 最新型の武装の試作機を優先的に配備される、イェルスの超エリート部隊の一員。開発主任の遊び心に翻弄され、泣きながら帰ってくる者もしばしば見受けられる。
jp_grezzo: "最新型の武装の試作機を優先的に配備される、イェルスの超エリート部隊の一員。開発主任の遊び心に翻弄され、泣きながら帰ってくる者もしばしば見受けられる。"
en: Members of the ultra-elite Yerles unit, where prototypes of the latest armaments are deployed as a priority. Often at the mercy of the chief development officer's playful attitude, some of them are seen returning home in tears.
en_grezzo: "Members of the ultra-elite Yerles unit, where prototypes of the latest armaments are deployed as a priority. Often at the mercy of the chief development officer's playful attitude, some of them are seen returning home in tears. "
it: Fa parte del reparto scelto fra gli scelti di Yerles, quello a cui i prototipi degli armamenti nuovi arrivano per primi. Lo spirito burlone del capo dello sviluppo se li rigira come vuole, e capita spesso di vederne tornare qualcuno in lacrime.

jp: 定職につかず、賭博により生計を立てようとしている輩の総称。金が無くなったものは知らぬ間に消えており、その行方を知る者は居ない。
jp_grezzo: "定職につかず、賭博により生計を立てようとしている輩の総称。金が無くなったものは知らぬ間に消えており、その行方を知る者は居ない。"
en: A general term for people who do not have regular jobs and try to make a living through gambling. Those who lose their money disappear without being noticed, and no one knows their whereabouts.
en_grezzo: "A general term for people who do not have regular jobs and try to make a living through gambling. Those who lose their money disappear without being noticed, and no one knows their whereabouts."
it: È il nome che si dà a tutti quelli che non hanno un lavoro fisso e cercano di campare con l'azzardo. Quelli che restano senza soldi spariscono senza che nessuno se ne accorga, e dove siano finiti non lo sa nessuno.

jp: イェルス軍の精鋭。取り込まれることは回避できたが、地面から伸びた菌糸に捕らえられ同化が進行してしまっている。人型を保てなくなるのも時間の問題だろう。
jp_grezzo: "イェルス軍の精鋭。取り込まれることは回避できたが、地面から伸びた菌糸に捕らえられ同化が進行してしまっている。人型を保てなくなるのも時間の問題だろう。"
en: The elites of the Yerles army. Although they were able to avoid being absorbed, they have been trapped by the mycelium growing from the ground and have undergone assimilation. It is only a matter of time before they are unable to retain their human form.
en_grezzo: "The elites of the Yerles army. Although they were able to avoid being absorbed, they have been trapped by the mycelium growing from the ground and have undergone assimilation. It is only a matter of time before they are unable to retain their human form."
it: Truppa scelta dell'esercito di Yerles. Di farsi inghiottire è riuscito a evitarlo, ma il micelio che spunta dal terreno lo ha afferrato e l'assimilazione va avanti. Che non riesca più a tenere la forma di uomo è solo questione di tempo.

jp: 死神が管理しているキャンドルが動き出した姿。瀕死で身動きが取れない人間に、熱したロウを垂らすのが趣味。頭の火は触っても不思議と熱くない。
jp_grezzo: "死神が管理しているキャンドルが動き出した姿。瀕死で身動きが取れない人間に、熱したロウを垂らすのが趣味。頭の火は触っても不思議と熱くない。"
en: A candle controlled by the Death that has been set in motion. It enjoys dropping hot wax on a dying, writhing human being. The fire in their heads is strangely not hot to the touch.
en_grezzo: "A candle controlled by the Death that has been set in motion. It enjoys dropping hot wax on a dying, writhing human being. The fire in their heads is strangely not hot to the touch."
it: Una candela che la Morte teneva in custodia e che si è messa in movimento. Il suo passatempo è gocciolare cera bollente addosso a chi è in fin di vita e non riesce più a muoversi. Il fuoco che ha in testa, stranamente, a toccarlo non scotta.

jp: プリンに対する沢山の愛が集まり、精霊となった。素朴な表情と相まって非常にスイーツであると人気。ただし死体はプリン味ではない。
jp_grezzo: "プリンに対する沢山の愛が集まり、精霊となった。素朴な表情と相まって非常にスイーツであると人気。ただし死体はプリン味ではない。"
en: One has double-downed on their love for pudding gathered and became a pudding spirit. Popular for being very sweet, combined with a simple facial expression. However, their corpses are not pudding-flavoured.
en_grezzo: "One has double-downed on their love for pudding gathered and became a pudding spirit. Popular for being very sweet, combined with a simple facial expression. However, their corpses are not pudding-flavoured."
it: Tanto amore per il budino si è raccolto in un punto solo, ed è nato uno spirito. Con quella faccia da ingenuo piace parecchio, e tutti lo trovano dolcissimo. Il cadavere, però, di budino non sa.

jp: すでにこの世を去った魔法使いたちの魔力の残滓が、大自然にあふれるマナと融合し精霊として独立した。特定の魔法に反応して寄ってくる。
jp_grezzo: "すでにこの世を去った魔法使いたちの魔力の残滓が、大自然にあふれるマナと融合し精霊として独立した。特定の魔法に反応して寄ってくる。"
en: The magical residues of wizards who have already left this world, have fused with the mana that abounds in the wilderness and become independent as spirits. They react to specific magic and come close to it.
en_grezzo: "The magical residues of wizards who have already left this world, have fused with the mana that abounds in the wilderness and become independent as spirits. They react to specific magic and come close to it. "
it: Quel che restava del potere magico dei maghi già andati via da questo mondo si è fuso con la mana di cui la natura abbonda, e se n'è staccato uno spirito. Se sente certe magie, arriva.

jp: 家族を守るため素手で魔物と戦い、刺し違えた者たちの魂の一部が精霊となった。その光り輝く拳は守るべき者のために振るわれる。
jp_grezzo: "家族を守るため素手で魔物と戦い、刺し違えた者たちの魂の一部が精霊となった。その光り輝く拳は守るべき者のために振るわれる。"
en: One fought demons with one's bare hands to protect his family, stabbed to death, and a part of their souls became spirits. Their shining fists are wielded for the sake of those they are supposed to protect.
en_grezzo: "One fought demons with one's bare hands to protect his family, stabbed to death, and a part of their souls became spirits. Their shining fists are wielded for the sake of those they are supposed to protect. "
it: C'è chi ha affrontato i mostri a mani nude per difendere la famiglia ed è morto uccidendo: un pezzo di quelle anime è diventato spirito. Quei pugni che risplendono si alzano per chi va protetto.

jp: 異常な素早さで彷徨する鐘の魔物。終末を知らせる鐘に命が宿り誕生した。物騒な存在だが、キャラメルが好きという意外な嗜好をもつ。
jp_grezzo: "異常な素早さで彷徨する鐘の魔物。終末を知らせる鐘に命が宿り誕生した。物騒な存在だが、キャラメルが好きという意外な嗜好をもつ。"
en: A bell monster that wanders around with abnormal speed. It was born when a bell signalling the end of the world came to life. It is a dangerous being, but it has a surprising fondness for caramels.
en_grezzo: "A bell monster that wanders around with abnormal speed. It was born when a bell signalling the end of the world came to life. It is a dangerous being, but it has a surprising fondness for caramels."
it: Un mostro a forma di campana, che vaga con una rapidità che non è normale. È nato quando la campana che annuncia la fine del mondo ha preso vita. È un essere inquietante, ma ha un debole che non ti aspetti: le caramelle mou.

jp: 幅広い分野の技術に精通しており、文明レベルに釣り合わないようなものを開発することもしばしば。周囲からは天才を超えてもはや変態扱いされている。
jp_grezzo: "幅広い分野の技術に精通しており、文明レベルに釣り合わないようなものを開発することもしばしば。周囲からは天才を超えてもはや変態扱いされている。"
en: He is familiar with technology in a wide range of fields and often develops things that are beyond the level of civilisation. He is regarded by those around him as being beyond a genius and is now considered to be a freak.
en_grezzo: "He is familiar with technology in a wide range of fields and often develops things that are beyond the level of civilisation. He is regarded by those around him as being beyond a genius and is now considered to be a freak. "
it: Conosce a fondo le tecniche dei campi più diversi, e non di rado tira fuori roba che col livello di civiltà di adesso non sta in piedi. Attorno a lui hanno smesso di chiamarlo genio: ormai lo trattano da svitato.

jp: 追い詰められたメシェーラの集合体が、吸収した素材を再構成して生み出した最も新しき災厄。オリジナルと比較すると色々な機能が欠けているものの、戦闘力は上。
jp_grezzo: "追い詰められたメシェーラの集合体が、吸収した素材を再構成して生み出した最も新しき災厄。オリジナルと比較すると色々な機能が欠けているものの、戦闘力は上。"
en: The latest disaster created by an assemblage of cornered Meshera, reconstituting the materials they have absorbed. Compared to the original, it lacks various functions, but has superior combat power.
en_grezzo: "The latest disaster created by an assemblage of cornered Meshera, reconstituting the materials they have absorbed. Compared to the original, it lacks various functions, but has superior combat power. "
it: L'ultima sciagura, generata dall'ammasso dei Meshera messi alle strette rimettendo insieme la materia che avevano assorbito. Rispetto all'originale gli mancano parecchie funzioni, ma in combattimento vale di più.

jp: 元未確認動物だが、環境の変化によって近年良く目撃されるようになってきた。野生動物や人の血液が主食で強靭な肉体を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "元未確認動物だが、環境の変化によって近年良く目撃されるようになってきた。野生動物や人の血液が主食で強靭な肉体を持つ。"
en: Formerly an unidentified animal, it has been sighted more frequently in recent years due to environmental changes. Its staple diet is wild animal and human blood, and it has a strong body.
en_grezzo: "Formerly an unidentified animal, it has been sighted more frequently in recent years due to environmental changes. Its staple diet is wild animal and human blood, and it has a strong body. "
it: Un tempo era un animale mai confermato, ma da qualche anno, con l'ambiente che cambia, lo si avvista spesso. Si nutre soprattutto del sangue degli animali selvatici e degli uomini, e ha un fisico tenace.

jp: 地獄の底から新鮮な血を求めてやってきた女吸血鬼。相手を完全に洗脳してからじっくりと吸血するのが趣味。どっちかというと女性を獲物にしたがる。
jp_grezzo: "地獄の底から新鮮な血を求めてやってきた女吸血鬼。相手を完全に洗脳してからじっくりと吸血するのが趣味。どっちかというと女性を獲物にしたがる。"
en: Female vampire hails from the depths of hell in search of fresh blood. Her hobby is to brainwash her opponents completely before slowly sucking their blood. She prefers to prey on women.
en_grezzo: "Female vampire hails from the depths of hell in search of fresh blood. Her hobby is to brainwash her opponents completely before slowly sucking their blood. She prefers to prey on women."
it: Una vampira salita dal fondo dell'inferno in cerca di sangue fresco. Il suo passatempo è lavare per bene il cervello alla vittima e poi succhiarle il sangue con tutta calma. Se può scegliere, preferisce le donne.

jp: 生血を主食としているが基本的に何でも食べる。本来は日光に弱い吸血鬼だが魔力を全身に纏うことで日光を遮断しており、白日の下でも活動可能。
jp_grezzo: "生血を主食としているが基本的に何でも食べる。本来は日光に弱い吸血鬼だが魔力を全身に纏うことで日光を遮断しており、白日の下でも活動可能。"
en: Their main source of nutrition is raw blood, but they will eat basically anything. Vampires are naturally vulnerable to sunlight, but they are able to work in broad daylight because they block sunlight by cloaking their entire body in magical powers.
en_grezzo: "Their main source of nutrition is raw blood, but they will eat basically anything. Vampires are naturally vulnerable to sunlight, but they are able to work in broad daylight because they block sunlight by cloaking their entire body in magical powers. "
it: Si nutre di sangue vivo, ma in sostanza mangia qualunque cosa. Un vampiro per natura teme la luce del sole; questo però si avvolge tutto quanto di potere magico e la respinge, così può muoversi anche in pieno giorno.

jp: 必死に意識だけは保っているが、全身を細菌に浸食されてもはや自分が誰だったのかすら分からなくなっている。自らを殺してくれる存在を待ち望んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "必死に意識だけは保っているが、全身を細菌に浸食されてもはや自分が誰だったのかすら分からなくなっている。自らを殺してくれる存在を待ち望んでいる。"
en: They are desperately trying to stay conscious, but their whole body has been so infested with bacteria that they no longer even know who they were. They are waiting for an entity that could kill them.
en_grezzo: "They are desperately trying to stay conscious, but their whole body has been so infested with bacteria that they no longer even know who they were. They are waiting for an entity that could kill them. "
it: Si aggrappa con le unghie alla coscienza, ma i batteri gli hanno corroso il corpo da capo a piedi e ormai non sa più nemmeno chi fosse. Aspetta con ansia qualcuno che gli dia la morte.

jp: メシェーラに侵された、元は魔法使いであったのだろう人間の成れの果て。意識はかすかに残っているが、今や細菌が脳の8割を侵食しており自由はない。
jp_grezzo: "メシェーラに侵された、元は魔法使いであったのだろう人間の成れの果て。意識はかすかに残っているが、今や細菌が脳の8割を侵食しており自由はない。"
en: The result of a human who may have once been a wizard, infected by Meshera. They are faintly conscious, but the bacteria have now invaded 80% of their brains and they are completely helpless.
en_grezzo: "The result of a human who may have once been a wizard, infected by Meshera. They are faintly conscious, but the bacteria have now invaded 80% of their brains and they are completely helpless. "
it: È quel che resta di un uomo invaso dai Meshera, e che prima doveva essere un mago. Un filo di coscienza gli è rimasto, ma i batteri gli hanno preso ormai l'ottanta per cento del cervello: di libertà non ne ha più.

jp: 身体は細菌の出す電気信号により制御されている。神経の乗っ取りが不完全であるため、素体となっている人間は常に激痛に苛まれている。
jp_grezzo: "身体は細菌の出す電気信号により制御されている。神経の乗っ取りが不完全であるため、素体となっている人間は常に激痛に苛まれている。"
en: Their bodies are controlled by electrical signals produced by the bacteria. Due to imperfect nerve take-over, the person who is the prime body is in constant severe pain.
en_grezzo: "Their bodies are controlled by electrical signals produced by the bacteria. Due to imperfect nerve take-over, the person who is the prime body is in constant severe pain. "
it: Il corpo glielo comandano i segnali elettrici che emettono i batteri. I nervi non sono stati presi per intero, e per questo l'uomo che gli fa da base soffre dolori atroci senza un attimo di tregua.

jp: 自身を食そうとする者たちを退け続けた結果、｢常に闘いの中に身を置く｣とされてこの名前が付けられた。やたら暑苦しいため他のきのこから敬遠されている。
jp_grezzo: "自身を食そうとする者たちを退け続けた結果、｢常に闘いの中に身を置く｣とされてこの名前が付けられた。やたら暑苦しいため他のきのこから敬遠されている。"
en: It was given this name as a result of constantly fending off those who tried to eat it, and as a result, it is considered to be 'always in the fight'. It is shunned by other mushrooms because it is extremely aggressive.
en_grezzo: "It was given this name as a result of constantly fending off those who tried to eat it, and as a result, it is considered to be 'always in the fight'. It is shunned by other mushrooms because it is extremely aggressive. "
it: Ha respinto per anni chiunque provasse a mangiarselo, e allora si è detto che sta sempre in mezzo alla battaglia e gli hanno dato questo nome. Ha una foga soffocante, e gli altri funghi lo tengono a distanza.

jp: 好奇心が強く、気になった物の後についていく。巣からすぐ脱走するので親竜は大変。鳥のヒナに似た鳴き声を発する。吠え方や火の吐き方は親から習うため、飼育する場合ちゃんと教えてやる必要がある。
jp_grezzo: "好奇心が強く、気になった物の後についていく。巣からすぐ脱走するので親竜は大変。鳥のヒナに似た鳴き声を発する。吠え方や火の吐き方は親から習うため、飼育する場合ちゃんと教えてやる必要がある。"
en: They are curious and follow things that interest them. Escaped from the nest quickly, causing problems for its parents. They make a chirping sound similar to that of bird chicks. Barking and fire breathing skills are learned from their parents, so they need to be taught properly if they are to be kept in captivity.
en_grezzo: "They are curious and follow things that interest them. Escaped from the nest quickly, causing problems for its parents. They make a chirping sound similar to that of bird chicks. Barking and fire breathing skills are learned from their parents, so they need to be taught properly if they are to be kept in captivity."
it: È curioso e va dietro a tutto quello che gli mette curiosità. Scappa dal nido in un attimo, e per i genitori sono guai. Il verso che fa somiglia a quello dei pulcini. A ruggire e a sputare fuoco impara dai genitori: chi se lo alleva glielo deve insegnare per bene.

jp: 西イルヴァ観光協会に所属。野盗やモンスターを文字通りちぎっては投げる大迫力の殺戮ショーで人気がある。たまに間違えて客をちぎってしまうことがある。
jp_grezzo: "西イルヴァ観光協会に所属。野盗やモンスターを文字通りちぎっては投げる大迫力の殺戮ショーで人気がある。たまに間違えて客をちぎってしまうことがある。"
en: Member of the West Irva Tourist Association. She is popular for her spectacular killing shows in which she literally tears off and throws wild thieves and monsters. Sometimes she tears apart her customers by mistake.
en_grezzo: "Member of the West Irva Tourist Association. She is popular for her spectacular killing shows in which she literally tears off and throws wild thieves and monsters. Sometimes she tears apart her customers by mistake."
it: Fa parte dell'associazione turistica di Irva occidentale. È famosa per i suoi spettacoli di massacro a grande effetto, dove briganti e mostri li fa a pezzi e li scaglia via per davvero. Ogni tanto, per sbaglio, fa a pezzi un cliente.

jp: マナを媒介に動く、対遺跡荒らし用の罠。棺の中にマナの供給源となる者を固定して動作させる。呪詛を撒き散らし、そのおぞましい姿は見た者を朦朧とさせる。
jp_grezzo: "マナを媒介に動く、対遺跡荒らし用の罠。棺の中にマナの供給源となる者を固定して動作させる。呪詛を撒き散らし、そのおぞましい姿は見た者を朦朧とさせる。"
en: Mana-mediated traps designed to counter grave robbers. It operates by trapping the victim, who is now the source of the mana, inside the coffin. Sprays curses and its horrifying appearance leaves the viewer in a daze.
en_grezzo: "Mana-mediated traps designed to counter grave robbers. It operates by trapping the victim, who is now the source of the mana, inside the coffin. Sprays curses and its horrifying appearance leaves the viewer in a daze."
it: Una trappola che si muove servendosi della mana, pensata contro chi va a saccheggiare le rovine. Funziona fissando dentro il sarcofago qualcuno che faccia da fonte di mana. Sparge maledizioni, e chi vede quella forma orrenda resta intontito.

jp: 死んで一度は肉体から離れた猫の魂が、自らの遺体に戻り誕生した。元の体に強い執着がある場合によく発生する。愛くるしさは生前のままだが、その体はどんどん朽ちていく。
jp_grezzo: "死んで一度は肉体から離れた猫の魂が、自らの遺体に戻り誕生した。元の体に強い執着がある場合によく発生する。愛くるしさは生前のままだが、その体はどんどん朽ちていく。"
en: The soul of a cat, once dead and separated from its body, returns to its own body and is reborn. This often occurs when they have a strong attachment to their original body. Although the loving nature of the soul remains the same as when it was alive, their body is rapidly deteriorating.
en_grezzo: "The soul of a cat, once dead and separated from its body, returns to its own body and is reborn. This often occurs when they have a strong attachment to their original body. Although the loving nature of the soul remains the same as when it was alive, their body is rapidly deteriorating."
it: È nato quando l'anima di un gatto morto, che dal corpo si era già staccata, è tornata dentro la propria carcassa. Succede spesso quando al corpo di prima si è molto attaccati. La tenerezza è la stessa di quando era vivo, ma il corpo gli va in pezzi giorno dopo giorno.

jp: 成長したリトルシスター。共生関係が必要無いほどの戦闘能力を誇るが、本来溜め込むはずのエネルギーを全て戦闘に使ってしまうため失敗作とされた。
jp_grezzo: "成長したリトルシスター。共生関係が必要無いほどの戦闘能力を誇るが、本来溜め込むはずのエネルギーを全て戦闘に使ってしまうため失敗作とされた。"
en: Grown-up Little Sister. She boasts such fighting ability that there is no need for a symbiotic relationship, but she was considered a failure because she uses all the energy she was supposed to accumulate for fighting.
en_grezzo: "Grown-up Little Sister. She boasts such fighting ability that there is no need for a symbiotic relationship, but she was considered a failure because she uses all the energy she was supposed to accumulate for fighting. "
it: Una Little Sister cresciuta. In combattimento vale al punto che di una simbiosi non ha più bisogno; ma siccome l'energia che dovrebbe mettere da parte la spende tutta a combattere, l'hanno giudicata un esperimento riuscito male.

jp: 幼いころに祖父に貰っていたキャンディに病み付きになり、自分の孫にも同じキャンディをあげている。演奏パーティーを開いては人を集めるのが趣味。
jp_grezzo: "幼いころに祖父に貰っていたキャンディに病み付きになり、自分の孫にも同じキャンディをあげている。演奏パーティーを開いては人を集めるのが趣味。"
en: He became addicted to the candy his grandfather gave him as a child and has been giving the same candy to his own grandchildren. He enjoys throwing performance parties and bringing people together.
en_grezzo: "He became addicted to the candy his grandfather gave him as a child and has been giving the same candy to his own grandchildren. He enjoys throwing performance parties and bringing people together. "
it: Da bambino si era preso il vizio dei dolciumi che gli dava il nonno, e adesso dà gli stessi dolciumi ai suoi nipoti. Il suo passatempo è organizzare feste con la musica e radunare gente.
